newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Huili buys into two firms.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Huili buys into two firms.

text.p: Shanghai Huili Building Materials has purchased stakes in two furniture firms for a total of 108 million yuan, using proceeds raised in a B share issue in June, a company statement said on Wednesday.
Huili invested 71 million yuan to buy a 75 percent stake in Shanghai Huili Floor Products and 37 million yuan to buy a 28.63 percent share of Shanghai Huihao Wood-door Manufacturing Co, it said.
Both firms are part of the Huili group, from which Huili Building was spun off as a separate company.
In June this year, Huili issued 80 million B shares to raise 123.2 million yuan.
